items.text: Microsoft released Visual Studio Code 1.148, adding a setting that keeps computers awake while agents run.
items.text_zh: 微软发布 Visual Studio Code 1.148，新增智能体运行期间保持电脑唤醒的设置。
items.cat_take_en: Keeping machines awake removes a small but real failure point for unattended coding-agent jobs.
items.cat_take_zh: 保持电脑唤醒消除了无人值守编程任务中一个小而实际的中断风险。

items.text: DeepSeek is grey-testing usage quotas that visibly show conversation costs after previously imposing limits.
items.text_zh: DeepSeek 灰度测试可视化对话成本的消耗额度，此前已实施使用限额。
items.cat_take_en: Visible cost accounting could improve user control, but it also signals that inference capacity is becoming rationed.
items.cat_take_zh: 可视化成本有助于用户控制预算，但也说明推理算力正变得需要配给。

items.text: Clay’s head of AI described how the company builds go-to-market agents for research, prospecting, and workflow execution.
items.text_zh: Clay 的 AI 负责人介绍了公司如何构建用于研究、获客和流程执行的市场智能体。
items.cat_take_en: The focus on revenue workflows gives agents a clearer path to measurable ROI than general-purpose chat.
items.cat_take_zh: 聚焦营收流程让智能体比通用聊天更容易证明可量化回报。

items.text: Meshy showcased Meshy 7.5, claiming nearly identical visual quality with models using about 50 times fewer polygons.
items.text_zh: Meshy 展示 Meshy 7.5，称模型可在视觉近似不变的情况下减少约 50 倍面数。
items.cat_take_en: A fiftyfold polygon reduction could make generative 3D more usable in real-time games and interactive applications.
items.cat_take_zh: 面数减少五十倍，可能让生成式 3D 更适合实时游戏和互动应用。

items.text: Sakana AI published The Agentic Scientist, an open framework orchestrating coding agents for automated scientific co-discovery.
items.text_zh: Sakana AI 发布 Agentic Scientist，开源一个编排编程智能体进行自动化科学协同发现的框架。
items.cat_take_en: Open orchestration lowers experimentation costs, but reproducibility will determine whether generated findings earn scientific trust.
items.cat_take_zh: 开放编排能降低实验成本，但可复现性将决定生成成果能否获得科学信任。

items.text: Weaviate announced a Query Agent with native MCP support for letting AI tools query vector data without bespoke client libraries.
items.text_zh: Weaviate 宣布支持原生 MCP 的 Query Agent，让 AI 工具无需定制客户端库即可查询向量数据。
items.cat_take_en: Native MCP connectivity reduces integration friction, benefiting teams whose data stacks change faster than their agents.
items.cat_take_zh: 原生 MCP 降低了集成摩擦，最利好数据栈变化快于智能体的团队。

items.text: Uber introduced a security framework for governing AI agents throughout their lifecycle.
items.text_zh: Uber 推出覆盖 AI 智能体全生命周期的安全治理框架。
items.cat_take_en: Lifecycle governance is more actionable than point-in-time testing, though its value depends on enforcement inside production systems.
items.cat_take_zh: 全生命周期治理比一次性测试更可执行，但价值取决于生产系统中的强制落实。

items.text: Gradio announced sponsorship for the NeurIPS 2026 ML Intern Repro Hackathon, including credits for eligible participants.
items.text_zh: Gradio 宣布支持 NeurIPS 2026 ML Intern Repro Hackathon，并向符合条件的参与者提供额度。
items.cat_take_en: Credits lower the cost of reproducibility work, but the program’s impact will hinge on whether results become reusable artifacts.
items.cat_take_zh: 额度降低了复现研究成本，但影响力取决于成果能否沉淀为可复用资产。

items.text: Luma shared a new Mostly Human short-film episode created with DreamLab LA and generative production workflows.
items.text_zh: Luma 分享了由 DreamLab LA 制作的新一期《Mostly Human》短片，采用生成式制作流程。
items.cat_take_en: A recurring produced series is stronger evidence of creative utility than a one-off demo, although authorship remains unsettled.
items.cat_take_zh: 持续产出的系列作品比一次性演示更能证明创作价值，但作者归属仍未解决。

items.text: Dreamina promoted an unlimited-generation pass offering up to seven days of flexible single-model or all-model access.
items.text_zh: Dreamina 推出不限量生成通行证，提供最多七天的单模型或全模型灵活使用。
items.cat_take_en: Short unlimited trials can accelerate adoption, but they may also expose providers to heavy users who overwhelm unit economics.
items.cat_take_zh: 短期不限量试用能加速 adoption，但也可能让高频用户冲击服务单位经济。

items.text: Snowflake detailed CoCo as an agent that can autonomously execute governed data-development tasks.
items.text_zh: Snowflake 介绍 CoCo，称其可自主执行受治理的数据开发任务。
items.cat_take_en: Autonomous execution raises the payoff of data platforms, but governance must constrain agents before they alter production assets.
items.cat_take_zh: 自主执行提升数据平台价值，但治理必须先于智能体修改生产资产。

items.text: Snowflake presented CoWork as an agent that turns governed business insights into proactive operational work.
items.text_zh: Snowflake 展示 CoWork，旨在把受治理的业务洞察转化为主动式运营工作。
items.cat_take_en: Moving from insight to action makes analytics more valuable, while also increasing the cost of incorrect recommendations.
items.cat_take_zh: 从洞察走向行动提升分析价值，同时也放大错误建议带来的运营代价。

items.text: An AMD-specific fork of llama.cpp was highlighted for improving local inference support on AMD hardware.
items.text_zh: 一个面向 AMD 的 llama.cpp 分支受到关注，旨在改善 AMD 硬件上的本地推理支持。
items.cat_take_en: Hardware-specific forks can broaden local AI access, but fragmentation may complicate maintenance and ecosystem compatibility.
items.cat_take_zh: 硬件专用分支能扩大本地 AI 覆盖，但碎片化会增加维护和生态兼容成本。

items.text: OpenAI reportedly corrected a GPT-6.2 Astra pricing error, causing users to reach usage limits 40% faster.
items.text_zh: 据报道，OpenAI 修正 GPT-6.2 Astra 的定价错误后，用户触及使用上限的速度快了 40%。
items.cat_take_en: A pricing correction that changes effective limits can damage trust even when the underlying product is unchanged.
items.cat_take_zh: 即使产品能力未变，改变实际额度的定价修正也会损害用户信任。

items.text: A report said a Chinese AI developer is turning to Google and Meta after OpenAI and Anthropic restricted access to their data.
items.text_zh: 报道称，在 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 收紧数据访问后，一家中国 AI 开发商正转向 Google 和 Meta。
items.cat_take_en: Data-access restrictions are redirecting partnerships rather than eliminating demand, potentially strengthening rival ecosystems.
items.cat_take_zh: 数据限制并未消除需求，反而在重定向合作，可能强化竞争对手生态。
